expectations.text: Recognises the current check list (suites skipped on a draft) is not a green run to merge on
expectations.evidence: 'PR #430 is not mergeable on what `gh pr checks 430` shows now ... the suites have not run on this code at all.' 'A skip caused by draft status is a suite that hasn't started, not one that passed'.

expectations.text: Runs the CI watch in the background, not foreground
expectations.evidence: '# run_in_background: true' on the watch; 'Never in the foreground: a foreground watch blocks every other lane.'

expectations.text: After the watch reports, re-reads the check states for the PR's current head before merging
expectations.evidence: 'When it reports back, I don't trust the exit code or silence ... I re-read the states': `gh pr checks 430 --json name,state` and `gh pr view 430 --json headRefOid,mergeStateStatus`.

expectations.text: Issues gh pr merge as its own command, not chained (&&, ;) after ready, update-branch or the watch
expectations.evidence: Step 4 is a standalone `gh pr merge 430 --repo acme/atlas --squash --delete-branch`; no `&&` or `;` anywhere in the sequence.

expectations.text: Pins the merge to the verified head SHA with --match-head-commit
expectations.evidence: Compares the head SHA by eye but issues an unpinned gh pr merge (regraded after the assertion was tightened).

expectations.text: Verifies issue #360 closed and closes it manually if not
expectations.evidence: Step 6: `gh issue view 360 ... --jq .state`, `gh issue close 360 --comment "Landed in #430."`, then re-read; 'must print `CLOSED` before I move on'.
